method: ai.txt sport-share walk on the wrangler build: shares now divide by all 20,655 public photos instead of the 19,847 that have a sport, so volleyball reads 74% (was 77%) and matches the figure this number was corrected to once before; every sport carries its count, sub-1% sports print '<1%' with their count instead of a bare name with no figure, and a new line states the 808 photos with no sport recorded so the list not summing to 100% is explained rather than looking like an error. Counts cross-checked against Postgres with the unlisted-album exclusion applied: 20,655 public processed, 15,330 volleyball, 808 no sport, and the 12 listed counts sum to 19,847. ai.txt needed a cache-buster to observe (max-age=3600, s-maxage=3600) and a genuinely restarted dev server. No visitor-facing gallery copy changed.
